knowledge-graph.d: A knowledge graph represents entities and their relationships as a typed graph with formal semantics, enabling reasoning and structured retrieval.

graph.d: A graph is a set of vertices connected by edges.

data-structure.d: An organisation of data for efficient access and modification.

graph-database.d: A database optimised for storing and querying graph-structured data with native traversal.

ontology.d: A formal, explicit specification of a shared conceptualisation of a domain.

vector-database.d: A database optimised for similarity search over high-dimensional embedding vectors.

semantic-web.d: An extension of the web in which data is given well-defined, machine-readable meaning.
